key.name: show-menu-keybinding
key.summary: Keybinding to show the passmate menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the passmate popup menu.

key.description: Which tab is shown when the menu opens: "passwords" or "totp".

key.description: The pass entry containing all TOTP otpauth:// URIs.

key.name: password-store-path
key.description: Custom path to the password store. Leave empty for ~/.password-store.
